description: This file defines the WPEFramework Plugin::Probe class, including nested classes for WebTransform, Listener, Broadcaster, and Instance. It appears to implement a network probe mechanism with multicast/broadcast capabilities, handling Web requests and responses, and managing probe instances with associated URLs, latency, and security attributes.

classes.name: Probe
classes.description: Main class implementing network probing with multicast/broadcast support, handling Web requests/responses, and managing probe instances.

classes.name: Probe::WebTransform
classes.description: Handles transformation of Web request data for the probe.

classes.name: Probe::Listener
classes.description: Listens for Web requests and responses, manages request validation and response creation.

classes.name: Probe::Broadcaster
classes.description: Handles broadcasting probe requests over the network via UDP datagrams.

classes.name: Probe::Instance
classes.description: Represents a probe instance with URL, latency, model, and security attributes.
